Solved growth (Stage 2): rate-independent growth law with irreversibility theta >= theta_n, solved by a primal-dual active set over quasi-static pseudo-time increments. The law is on when threshold is set (a number or a per_element_file); threshold "none" (the default) leaves theta prescribed (growth_nodal_field) or fixed.
Constant activation threshold phi [Pa], in units of the driving force f_I = -(1/vn) d(J^g psi_e)/d theta; the dissipation is int vn phi (theta - theta_n) dV, so growth activates where f_I = phi.
Per-element threshold read from a legacy ASCII VTK file, bound by global element id
No threshold: the growth law is off (the default; theta is prescribed or fixed).

Pseudo-time of the last increment; displacement Dirichlet expressions are evaluated at t = t_end * k / n_steps
Maximum active-set passes per increment before the solve stops with an error
A pinned growth DOF is released when dPi/dtheta < -active_set_tol * max(1 Pa, |phi|_max) * int N_a dV
A free growth DOF is pinned when theta < theta_n - feasibility_tol
Positivity filter on line-search steps: theta >= theta_floor_fraction * theta_n (keeps det F^g > 0; irreversibility itself is the active set)

Write the converged state after every increment as growth_step_<k>.vtu (k = 1..n_steps, same fields as the final export, incl. growth_pinned and growth_activation_step) plus growth_steps.pvd, in the output folder

frozen: the threshold file's field is phi_e for the whole run (route B at the end state's C_check). lagged: only the dissipative part phi_par (parallel_field) is frozen; the shear supply f_gamma is re-evaluated at the start of every increment on the previous increment's converged displacement, phi_e = phi_par,e + f_gamma,e (needs theta_crit)
shear_supply lagged: the threshold in-plane elastic area stretch of the C_check construction (theta = theta_tot / theta_crit)
shear_supply lagged: CELL_DATA field of the threshold file holding max(f_par(C_check), 0) [Pa]

shear_supply lagged: when f_gamma is re-evaluated. increment: once per increment, on the previous increment's converged state. predictor: on the increment's elastic predictor (pass 1, growth pinned), i.e. the displacement at this increment's t, at no extra solve. pass: after every active-set pass, re-solving until the threshold moves by less than shear_update_tol
shear_update pass: the per-pass iteration stops when max |d phi_e| < shear_update_tol [Pa] (and the active set has settled)

Dissipative part PHI_PAR = max(f_par(C_check), 0) of the route-B threshold. file: the threshold file's parallel_field (V0b). state: computed by the solver at C_check of the displacement in threshold_state (default input.data.state), with its own energy and fibers, then frozen (with shear_supply frozen, f_gamma from the same state). lagged: re-evaluated with f_gamma on the current state (timing shear_update; needs shear_supply lagged); with shear_update pass this is the in-increment re-lag. state and lagged need theta_crit
parallel_threshold state: state file (with the displacement u) at which C_check is built; empty uses input.data.state. Resolved relative to the input JSON

Log, per increment, the lag residual |phi(converged state) - phi used| and the attainment vartheta^e/theta_crit over grown unclamped elements, and export growth_lag_residual and growth_attainment (needs theta_crit)

When < 1: once the active set has settled, one confirmation pass re-solves with solver.nonlinear.grad_norm_tol multiplied by this factor, and the set is re-checked on the tighter multipliers (1 = off)
shear_update pass: acceleration of the per-pass threshold iteration. aitken: Aitken / Irons-Tuck dynamic relaxation on (PHI_PAR, f_gamma), restarted whenever the active set changes; same fixed point
relag_acceleration aitken: lower clamp on the relaxation factor
relag_acceleration aitken: upper clamp on the relaxation factor
